name: Abraham van Beijeren

summary.text: Abraham Hendriksz van Beijeren was a Dutch painter and drafter. Little recognized in his day, Van Beijeren is considered one of the most important painters of pronkstilleven style still lifes.
summary.title: Abraham van Beijeren
